description: Every family of infinite subsets of the natural numbers of size less than the bounding number has a common splitter.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.small_family_has_splitter (F : Set (Set ℕ)) (hi : ∀ X ∈ F, X.Infinite)
  (hc : Cardinal.mk ↑F < Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.boundingNumber) :
  ∃ S, ∀ X ∈ F, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.Splits S X
